service.name: Manderville Relic Weapon
service.longDescription: A Manderville weapon is never simply forged — it is dramatically unveiled. Every stage of the Endwalker relic chain, from the base blade to Mandervillous, completed on your account.

rewards.title: Any Step of the Relic Chain
rewards.text: From the base stage to the final glow — pick exactly the steps you need, priced per step.

rewards.title: Relic Weapon for Your Job
rewards.text: The Endwalker Manderville Weapon for your chosen job, at any stage.

rewards.title: All Materials Kept
rewards.text: Tomestones, crystals and every material farmed along the way stays on your character.

rewards.title: Achievement Unlocked
rewards.text: Achievement unlocked upon completing the relic chain.

accordion.title: Requirements
items: Manderville weapon questline unlocked (available as an additional service)
